name: Nekomata

partner_info.impression_f:
Kitty cat! Who doesn't like kitty cats!
Ohhh, I want to touch Nekomata's tails! She's got two, that's double the fun!
partner_info.impression_m:
Take it easy... She's not some harmless little kitten on the street in New Eridu...
When dealing with Nekomata, the most important thing is keeping an eye on your wallet...
impressions:
Impressions of Nekomata:
 · The gratitude of a cat is always so touching... except when they give a dead mouse.
· Despite leaving the Red Fang Gang for a while, Nekomata still commands respect within the gang
· The stray cat finally has a place it can come back to, a place to call "home."
partner_info.profile_desc:
Nekomiya Mana. Refers to herself as "Nekomata."
A cat Thiren with feline traits, possessing great dexterity when hunting and an insatiable curiosity about the outside world.
Sometimes mischievous, she engages in harmless pranks. But when she sets her sights on a target, her feline-like agility and focus are enough to leave others in awe.
She's most interested in other people's wallets.
Recommendation: Always keep an eye on your wallet when Nekomata is around.

In the past, Nekomata was a member of the long-standing Red Fang Gang. Its leader, Miguel Silver, took on a fatherly role in her life. Nonetheless, due to differing beliefs from the gang, she opted to part ways and go it alone.
Following certain encounters involving Nicole and others, she eventually opted to enlist in Gentle House, thus becoming the third employee on the team.
unlock_condition: Complete Agent Story "Cat and Mouse Game"

description.name: Basic Attack: Kitty Slash
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
On the last hit, there is a 33.33% chance to repeat this hit 3 times.

description.name: Basic Attack: Kitty Slash
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When the final slash lands on a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.

description.name: Basic Attack: Crimson Blade
description.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the first 3 hits of Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front and passes through them, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activation, there is a 33.33% chance to repeat this attack 3 times.

description.name: Basic Attack: Crimson Blade
description.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the first three hits of Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front and passes through them, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If this skill hits a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.

description.name: Dodge: Can't Touch Me-ow~
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dodge: Disappearing Tail
description.desc:
With at least 40 <Term:1000024><color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color></Term> and after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> and consume 30 Purr Energy to activate:
Nekomata enters Vital View and swiftly moves behind the enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. This skill does not consume dodge uses.

description.name: Dash Attack: Over Here!
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Phantom Claws
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Disappearing Tail</color>, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> with at least 40 <Term:1000024><color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color></Term> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Surprise Attack
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Surprise Attack
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!
description.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash that deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!
description.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!
Chain Attack: Claw Swipe
description.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Claw Smash
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Quick Assist: Cat's Paw
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Desperate Defense
description.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Shadow Strike
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Bird Hunter
1.desc: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
1.desc2: While Nekomata lacks strength due to her small size, she has the perceptiveness and agility required to locate her enemies' weaknesses and strike right where it hurts most.

2.name: Cat & Mouse
2.desc: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.
2.desc2:
Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.

3.name: Curious Left Tail
3.desc2:
According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within...
Even if that's not true, the experience Nekomata has gained on the streets certainly is.

4.name: Sharpen Claws
4.desc: When Nekomata uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.
4.desc2:
"Gimme more, gimme MORE! I can eat 'em all~"
Her eyes sparkle as she licks the back of her paws.

5.name: Lucky Right Tail
5.desc2: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within... Sometimes Nekomata wonders to herself: If she is lucky enough to keep surviving, will she eventually grow another tail?

6.name: Predator Lineage
6.desc: When Nekomata launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
6.desc2:
"When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
their latent animalistic tendencies emerge.
Fortunately, these tendencies aren't permanent..."
—Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens

name: Core Passive: Stealthy Paws
Additional Ability: Catwalk
desc:
When Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> hits an enemy, her DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Nekomata gains 40 <Term:1000024><color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color></Term> upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
When using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw, Nekomata enters the <Term:1000025><color=#FFFFFF>Pawpad Ambush</color></Term> state for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

When another character in your squad is a Support character, or shares the same attribute or Faction:
After Nekomata uses <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Disappearing Tail</color>, or after any squad member inflicts <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy, Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> deal 35% more DMG on hit. This effect stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

This effect stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
